## Pruna P-Video-2 Pro Avatar

One portrait plus one line of speech becomes a talking video. The portrait sets the identity and the
scene; the speech is either spoken by text-to-speech or supplied as your own audio.

### How to use

1. Sign in with your ComfyUI account. This is an API node, it bills per second of rendered video.
2. Load a head-and-shoulders portrait with the hands free and the face unobstructed. The video keeps
   the portrait's aspect ratio between 1:2 and 4:1; anything wider is cropped to 16:9 or 9:16.
3. `speech` = `script` (default): type the words, then choose `voice` and `language`. `voice_prompt`
   directs tone and pacing and is never spoken itself. `speech` = `audio`: connect a LoadAudio clip
   instead and its length becomes the render length.
4. `prompt` describes what the video shows: motion, camera, light. `resolution` at 1080p, 2k or 4k
   upscales the 768p render. 2k is limited to 150 seconds of speech and 4k to 60 seconds.
5. `seed` reproduces a result exactly only when `enhance_prompt` is off.

## Report Issue

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
